notes.title: Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows - Patch 1.2.0.23 is live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/66047c9ceeaa4cb07a33af2bf7f6e1e8b084d3e6.png

Konnichiwa, Waifu Shop Owners! 💝

First of all, thank you for your support and the almost exclusively positive reviews in the days since release! 🌸

We're especially happy about the active uploads in the Steam Workshop! Unfortunately, we had some technical issues with thumbnail uploads from within the application at release. With today's patch, these have been fixed, which means you can now equip your existing mods with nice preview images :)

Here's an overview of the patch notes:

Bug Fixes 🛠️

- We improved customer navigation in the store entry area to prevent them from getting stuck in a corner if a decoration blocks their path.

- We fixed an issue where cashiers sometimes weren't assigned to cash registers when loading a save.

- To unlock the achievement where you need to sell pillows without profit, it's no longer necessary to sit at the cash register yourself. Cashiers now also contribute progress toward this achievement.

- We fixed the setting that allows you to disable advertisements not working. When ads are turned off, the screens are now black.

- We fixed an issue where images from mods couldn't be loaded when they were placed in subfolders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/73abb6ce0ce14deb22d1d1d46751f91156ed2b14.png

Steam Workshop UI Improvements 🖼️

- If a mod has a thumbnail, we now show it in the list.

- We now show a warning if a mod has no thumbnail or description, with a tooltip that explains how to solve the issue.

- We fixed issues with special characters (\t, \n, etc.) in paths when uploading a mod.

- We fixed the issue where it wasn't possible to edit the thumbnail or description after the initial upload of a mod.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/7feb6fcbb3fd292d46e4740f3f0a93436225e096.png

Performance & Stability ⚡

We've optimized many things here and expect your larger shops to run noticeably better. If not, please contact us! Preferably with a save file that we can test. You can find instructions on where to locate it here.

Sayonara - We look forward to your feedback on the new patch and wish you continued fun selling pillows! 👗✨

Stable regards,
Three River Games (3RG)

💬 Join us on Discord:
https://discord.gg/WpxwA9B8G3

Konnichiwa, Waifu-Shop Owners! 💝

Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows is available NOW!

Open your own Waifu Shop, decorate it however you like, and sell over 60 different pillows to your customers. Play alone or in multiplayer - with over 20 hours of gameplay and full mod support, there's something for everyone! 🎮🛒

Thanks to everyone that played early 🙏
We would like to thank everyone who played our demo during Steam Next Fest and especially all playtesters who supported us in recent weeks.

Arigatō and have fun selling pillows! ❤️

Stable regards,

notes.title: Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows - Release Announcement!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/b429135034000b719f55dc20d3951926a3e64124.png

Konnichiwa, Waifu Shop Owners! 💝

First of all, a huge thank you to all playtesters who have already checked out the game and provided us with feedback! Amazing work!! 😎

The Demo is Live! 🌸

Starting today, you can download the Shop Simulator: Waifu Pillows demo for free on Steam! The demo will be available at least until the end of Steam Next Fest (03/03/2025).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353617/d630a3264d21ed9f982d4aac38e9e60d81fe89aa.png

Mod Support Already in the Demo! 💝

The demo comes with full mod support! This means you can start developing your own mods right away. You'll find a detailed tutorial in the second video on our Steam page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3361340/Shop_Simulator_Waifu_Pillows/

So When Will the Full Version Release? 🎌

From Monday, March 3rd, 2025, at 5:00 PM CET (UTC +1), you can purchase and download the game!

Add the game to your wishlist to help us get more visibility from the mighty Steam algorithm in the first few hours, and of course, so you don't miss the release! :)

Sayonara - We hope you enjoy the demo! 👗✨

Best wishes,
Three River Games (3RG)

💬 Join us on Discord:
https://discord.gg/WpxwA9B8G3
